title: Aesthetics PPL
author: Edgar Blanco
desc:
This intermediate training program is designed to hypertrophy, specially focused on the muscles work to get an aesthetic body. Perfect for those with some experience in lifting. I’m following this program after 9 months of body recomposition and I’m getting good results.

The exercises were chosen considering that they are as safe and least harmful as possible for your joints.

The workout is 6 day PPL (Push/Pull/Legs) split. I do recommend to rest one day after complete the first three training days, then perform the remaining days and rest again:

PUSH A
PULL A
LEGS A
REST
PUSH B
PULL B
LEGS B
REST

*KEY POINTS*

1. Don’t miss the notes I left above some exercises.

2. Remember keep stressing your muscles by a progressive overload every week. Increase the weight, sets or reps to challenge yourself.

3. Perform your ABS workout routine at the end of the legs training (15 min it’s fair enough).

4. Even if you are bulking do at least two days of 15/20 min cardio on pull or push workout days.


> I wish you all a good journey grinding!

ex.note:
I do recommend going to failure on 3, 4 and 5 sets.
Use the 4 set to try to increase the weight if you feel confident.
I do recommend going to failure on the last set.
Perform the exercise with the cable from LOW to HIGH to target your upper chest!!! Squeeze it at the end.

ss.note: Single arm CABLE kickback.

ex.note:
First set as a warm up with an assisted band.
Perform a descending pyramid from your AMRAP - min 5 reps (use a band if it’s necessary).
I do recommend going to failure on the last set.
I do recommend neutral close grip here.
Perform a single dropset of 50% on the last set to failure.
Perform a single dropset of 20% on the last set to failure.
I do recommend going approach to failure on the last set.
Perform a 2 seconds down pause on every rep to keep your muscles under tension.
Perfom every rep with an explosive movement up and slow eccentric.
Perfom every rep with an explosive concentric movement and slow eccentric.
